title: Choose DriveBoard's look (familiar set)
question: Three familiar directions, plus the category standard. Pick one, or re-roll.

options.label: Highway Sign Green
options.lineage: JKR highway direction signs on every Malaysian expressway
options.thesis: Every widget is a highway sign panel: white type on sign green, the next prayer posted like an exit with its countdown in amber.
options.viewport: Phone: a dark board preview of green sign panels, the prayer countdown as an amber exit tag; white settings list below.
options.risk: Lots of green can feel heavy at night; the inset sign border must stay one line, never grow into a costume.

options.label: e.MAS Cabin Calm
options.lineage: the calm graphite-and-teal look of modern EV cabins
options.thesis: Quiet graphite that blends into the e.MAS dashboard, with one teal charge strip that is literally your battery level.
materials: battery as a full-width teal strip
options.viewport: Phone: a graphite board with widgets divided by hairlines and a teal battery strip along the bottom edge; light settings list below.
options.risk: Closest to the dark-plus-one-accent default; its distinction rests entirely on the battery strip.

options.label: Masjid Stone & Teal
options.lineage: limestone, deep teal and brass of Malaysian masjid interiors
options.thesis: Deep teal panels with brass details; a single eight-point star marks the next prayer, nothing else is ornamented.
options.viewport: Phone: a teal board with the star beside the next prayer and brass countdown; warm stone settings list below.
options.risk: Ornament can creep; the star must stay the only motif or it turns into decoration.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Material 3 dark, at the craft level of Android Auto's own dashboard, AutoDeck and Samsung One UI widgets.
canonCard.viewport: Phone: Material top bar, a rounded dark board preview, Material list settings.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from AutoDeck and every Android Auto widget app, by design.
